name: Thunder Lizard Horn
summary: In the Barrens, Brewmaster Drohn seeks a Thunder Lizard Horn for Chen Stormstout's legendary brew.

sections.title: A Potent Brewing Reagent
sections.body: Thunder lizards roam the Barrens with crested bodies crackling with lightning. In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn prizes their horns for Stormstout ale. His mentor learned the recipe from the wandering pandaren Brewmaster Chen Stormstout and passed it to Drohn. The horn gives the drink its potent kick.

faq.q: What is the horn used for?
aliases: why do i need thunder lizard horn
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet uses the horn in the brew Chen Stormstout made famous.

faq.q: Which beasts yield a thunder lizard horn?
aliases: where to get thunder lizard horn
faq.answer: Thunderheads, stormsnouts, thunderstomps, stormhides, and the elusive Owatanka can yield a thunder lizard horn.
Brewmaster Drohn brews in Ratchet. His former mentor learned the Stormstout recipe from Chen Stormstout and passed it down to him.

faq.q: Are thunder lizards dangerous to hunt for their horns?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards can discharge lightning and unleash thunderous stomps when provoked. Hunting them alone is dangerous.

angles.text: As a cook, you may find Drohn's recipe unusual. It combines plainstrider organs, predator tusks, and a beast's horn into an intoxicating drink.
As a hunter, take care when tracking thunder lizards across the open savannah. Their lightning makes them deadlier than ordinary Barrens kodo or plainstriders.
